value.why: Optimum.lean:5449 frontier_keeps_stepwise concludes Keeps m n x at every horizon under r ≤ q + c and e < c, the defining law of a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon. Its coupled (drawnOver + c (n + 1) ≤ worth on a keeping course) is optimum-coupled-at-least with w = c (n + 1); its coupledAt lets a course kept through j and falling at j + 1 be worth up to drawnOver + c j, so the premise that a course falling below m is worth no more than it draws (optimum-uncoupled, uncoupled of frontier_keeps_above) no longer holds: a coupling for each step kept in place of one all or nothing

What changes is the treatment of courses that break: frontier_keeps_above's uncoupled gives them nothing beyond their draw, frontier_keeps_stepwise's coupledAt credits them c for each step kept (Optimum.lean:5453). The drop is optimum-uncoupled.
